text: They keep you inside the story and make sure you never lose the meaning.

hero.title: You’re the main character
hero.text: Every new scene is illustrated like a film still. Upload your portrait, and you’ll find yourself inside the picture.

emotions.title: Emotions on character portraits
emotions.text: You’ll see how they feel about you before you even start reading the reply: neutral, cheerful, annoyed, friendly and more.

speechLevel.title: You choose how complex the speech is
speechLevel.text: At beginner levels, characters speak in short, simple phrases. Turn off the limit, and they’ll talk the way native speakers do.
speechLevel.freeLine: ¡Buenas! Dame un segundito, enseguida te atiendo.

translation.title: Translation of every phrase
translation.text: Tap the text, and the translation appears right next to it.

dictionary.title: A dictionary that sees context
dictionary.text: Tap a word, and the dictionary explains what it means right here. If neighbouring words change the meaning, it shows them together.

plots.title: 12 storylines to choose from
plots.text: A café, a market, a hotel, passport control, a trip to the dentist, a stranger at your door and more. New ones are coming soon.
